items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: From Paul, yeah, Paul Shalini, my godfather.

ctx.x: I thought maybe you were named after Shalini or somebody, I don't know.
Shalini, well yeah, that's how I got my name. From him? From Paul, yeah, Paul Shalini, my godfather.

items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: Paul come from Paul, shiny name, my godfather. He was a music teacher, you know. He taught a lot of boys.

ctx.x: That's right. And what's your name?

My name, you want my full name? I don't like to use a full name, you know. But we already got it once. You already got it once. We can just use your short name. My short name, Paul Barberin. Okay. My full name happens to be Adolph Paul Barberin. Adolph Paul Barberin. That's your first name. That's my first name, yeah. I never liked that name because of the county name. It's antique, ancient.
